full_prompt_en: A delicate modern oil still life places a handful of wildflowers in clear glass vessels on a gray windowsill. The main narrow vase stands just left of center and holds very long thin stems, an airy white umbrella-shaped flower head, tiny seed clusters, and scattered orange-yellow blooms. A smaller blue-and-white vessel sits at the right with a few quieter stems. Between them rests a small white blocklike object with a modest red square mark. Beyond the sill, a pale coastal landscape stretches into distance: a horizontal blue water band, low cream dunes, and a washed-out gray sky. The flowers are not packed into a lush bouquet; they remain separate points and lines, allowing the open background to show through. Their thin brown stems rise from the lower central gathering and branch outward asymmetrically, while small orange petals and dark purple seed heads punctuate the light field. The painting uses very thin layers of color and dry, broken touches. Large areas of pearly white, cool gray, pale blue, and warm sand remain quiet, with orange and yellow concentrated in a few small flower heads and the grassy lower-left corner. Glass is suggested by faint contours and a slight watery tint, not by hard reflective highlights. A soft gray strip of tabletop anchors the objects; the distant view is flattened and nearly weightless. Daylight is diffuse, with no strong shadow and only subtle tonal shifts across wall, landscape, and sill. The composition feels open and tentative, like a moment of looking through fragile stems toward sea air and distant light.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅细腻现代油画静物把少数野花放在灰色窗台上的透明玻璃器皿里。主窄瓶位于中央略左，插着很长很细的茎、一朵疏朗白色伞形花、微小种穗及散落橙黄花朵。右侧较小蓝白容器里还有几枝更安静的花茎。两者之间有一件带小红方块标记的白色块状物。窗台之外，浅淡海岸风景伸向远方：一道水平蓝色水带、低奶油沙丘和洗淡的灰天。花并未挤成丰盛花束；它们作为分离的点与线，让开放背景从中透过。细棕茎从下方中央汇集处升起，不对称地分枝，橙色小花瓣和深紫种穗点亮浅色域。画面使用极薄色层和干涩断续笔触。大片珠白、冷灰、浅蓝与暖沙色保持安静，橙黄只集中于少数小花头及左下草地。玻璃由淡轮廓和轻水色暗示，而非硬反光高光。柔灰桌面色带锚定物件；远景被压平，几乎失去重量。日光漫射，没有强影，墙面、风景与窗台间仅有细微明度变化。构图开放而试探，像透过脆弱花茎望向海风和远处光线的一刻。
style_prompt_en: Airy modern oil painting works with thin washes, dry broken touches, and abundant pale negative space. Pearly white, cool gray, powder blue, and warm sand spread across broad, nearly flat horizontal fields; tiny orange, yellow, violet, and brown marks provide sparse accents. Long fine lines rise from a narrow lower cluster and branch asymmetrically through the open field. Edges are soft and incomplete, with forms suggested by selective strokes rather than fully enclosed contours. Transparent surfaces are indicated by faint overlaps and watery tints, while matte ground carries subtle canvas grain. Diffuse daylight produces very little cast shadow, so small temperature shifts and tonal intervals carry the sense of depth. A low horizontal strip anchors the composition, and a distant blue band barely separates foreground from beyond. The rhythm is light, spacious, and fragile, balancing slender vertical marks with calm washed horizontal planes.
style_prompt_zh: 疏朗现代油画依靠薄色洗染、干涩断笔和大量浅色留白。珠白、冷灰、粉蓝和暖沙色在宽阔近乎平坦的水平色域上展开；微小橙、黄、紫与棕笔点构成稀疏重点。长细线从狭窄下方簇群升起，不对称地分枝穿过开放色域。边缘柔而不完整，形体由选择性笔触暗示，而不全部以闭合轮廓围住。透明表面由淡叠压和水样色调提示，哑光底面带微妙画布纹。漫射日光几乎不生投影，因此小小色温变化与明度间隔承载深度。低水平色带锚住构图，远处蓝带仅微弱区分前方与彼方。节奏轻盈、宽敞、脆弱，以细竖笔痕平衡安静洗淡的水平平面。
theme_en: Sparse wildflowers in glass vessels on a sill overlooking a pale coastal landscape
theme_zh: 浅色海岸风景前窗台玻璃器皿中的疏朗野花
name: Winifred Nicholson
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
